scientific_integrity: An explicit induction proves every-cutoff rigidity; independently implemented finite arithmetic checks through cutoff eight corroborate the hypotheses and lower-dimensional cases. Publication priority has not been independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Only the monoids of nonnegative integer sumsets containing zero with sums above an integer cutoff discarded are classified; not modular addition, arbitrary quotient monoids, endomorphisms, Boolean semiring automorphisms, or arbitrary infinite monoids. Potential earlier presentations under finite Boolean convolution or Toeplitz terminology remain a priority risk.
title: Rigidity of finite cutoff sumset monoids
